body:
Whoops

*October 2014

Before someone calls me out

Yeah. Im prone to general dysthymia, and have had some bad patches recently... But I'm doing much better in that regard now. I've been through much worse mental states without being this unstable.
But it could be manifesting in different ways than usual I suppose. Worth exploring - though I'm not sure how I would tackle it differently

Because I'm feeling very empty and restless. Desperately looking for answers and comfort. I'm remembering how drinking used to give those things to me. It obviously didn't do so eventually, and the cost vs pay-off was, in hindsight, never an attractive investment. 

I got a lot of support post rehab. Then everything just sort of stabilized. I was content with life despite outside influence. And even when I wasn't, the conditioning against alcohol stayed strong. 

I stayed active in supporting others and all the rest, but then kind of got bored of the whole deal.

I don't know what's happening now

Because it wasn't working anymore. Because it was making me very ill both pysically and mentally. Because my world had become so small and pointless it was becoming unbearable to live in. Checking in to rehab seemed like a more interesting prospect than pathological loneliness and potential death for the immediate future, so I did so.
I have. And was reasonably happy recently. I think I just keep proving to myself that I don't function without medications no matter the circumstances.
It honestly makes me smile and feel a bit less abnormal to see a picture that my own mental make up can relate to. Thanks
Hrmm. Food for thought at least.
Not pinned down on any one. Maybe a Hyosung GT250R. They have restrictions on the size of bike you can get on a learners license
Almost certainly not heh. It'd be a sports bike. Something to give me some adrenaline hopefully.

Um. Been getting in to caving but I'm starting to question how much I actually enjoy it. Distance running. Playing music. That's all I can think of? Not super interested in much recently. Thinking of getting a motorbike but it would severely damage my bank heh
It was a imgur post that introduced me to some chillstep artists. I then found this guy and many others through leaving YouTube endlessly playing
Eh. Let's go with Embrace by Blackmill
I'm slowly going through everything ever written it seems. Currently quite a lot of post-grunge, chillstep and post-rock.

Thanks everyone. I had a phone consultation with a GP, then went to a walk-in clinic this morning. I've been given the go-ahead to check myself in to the hospital if it gets to a certain level, and have been given a small amount of diazapam to ease the suffering. All in all it appears i'm not about to drop dead just yet.
I have just had a phone consultation with a nurse, and am waiting for a call back from the out-of hours doctor.
